name: narrow_range_7_breakout_5s
author: adapted from Gemini Quant
thesis: Exploits the NR7 pattern (Narrowest Range of last 7 days). This indicates extreme volatility compression. Intraday, if an NR7 stock breaks its previous day's high/low, it signifies a 'range expansion' phase. Market microstructure forces (stop hunting) propel the move once the range is broken.
mechanism: Volatility compression (squeeze) indicates that market makers have tightened their quotes around a narrow range. When a catalyst breaks the equilibrium, the compressed energy releases as participants rush to reposition. The thin order book beyond the compression zone allows rapid price movement with minimal resistance.
weaknesses: NR7 days can sometimes be followed by NR8 days (dead markets)
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; stop/target recalibration for 5-second timeframe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
